test_result: Fresh run exit 0: 6 test_that blocks, 94 expectations, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Dense Laplace oracle logLik agreement (abs 1e-4) for animal A + iid, relmat K/Q + iid, and phylo-interaction intercept, probit and cloglog.
scope: Native Binomial probit and cloglog: animal(1 | id, A = A) + (1 | site); relmat(1 | population, K = K) and relmat(1 | population, Q = Q) each + (1 | group); phylo_interaction(1 | plant:pollinator, tree1, tree2) intercept; each with separate predictor-dependent SDs. Dense Laplace oracle (abs 1e-4) on every fit (relmat Q fit has its own oracle), max gradient < 2e-2, prediction identity 1e-8, constant-SD equivalence (logLik 1e-5, coefficients 1e-3), SD-slope recovery within 0.5.
limits: native engine only, one fixture per cell, loose recovery bands, no interval calibration, no Julia parity, dirty shared tree, unreviewed. Evidence grade focused_test: oracle or equivalence checks with loose SD-recovery bounds, not a calibration study. Provider inputs or layouts not named in scope were not tested (not tested, not fenced).
review_note: Independent review confirmed a plain-R dense Laplace oracle (damped Newton mode, observed Hessian, log|I+Sigma Z'WZ|, hand-written probit and cloglog derivatives) that does not call drmTMB. It supports all 8 linked rows: native Binomial probit and cloglog; iid(site or group) plus animal(A), relmat(K) or relmat(Q), each with separate sd() formulas on both fields; and the phylo_interaction intercept with an SD regression. Oracle agreement is 1e-4 at fitted parameters. The relmat-Q fit has its own oracle built from solve(Q). The phylo-interaction pair covariance kronecker(A2,A1) uses the package tip-covariance helper. I checked that helper separately against ape::vcv (max difference 3e-16 on rcoal, 0 on the balanced 8-tip tree up to depth scaling), so it is not circular. The test has no emulated-bug block. A scratch check (no files edited) on animal+iid probit gave oracle gaps of 24.5 (swapped SD curves), 15.4 (reversed animal SDs) and 4.0 (constant SD), against 1e-4 tolerance. Focused test rerun on the current worktree: 94 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, 0 skipped. Manifest rehash: 4 of 7 entries differ (R/drmTMB.R, R/random-effect-targets.R, R/predict-parameters.R, src/drmTMB.cpp). They were changed by later lane commits and the receipt records a dirty tree, so the old states could not be reproduced. The current-file rerun is the evidence. Does not establish logit, other provider layouts (e.g. Ainv or pedigree), calibration, coverage or Julia parity. Recovery bands are loose (0.5). One fixture per cell.
